---
title: "Policy research"
description: "Policy research on municipal finance, global value chains and urban sustainability, written for governments in low-resource settings."
---

For a decade I wrote for and worked alongside finance ministries, city
treasuries and mayoral teams across Africa, Asia and the Caribbean, mostly
through the International Growth Centre's Cities that Work initiative, and
before that as an economist embedded in Guyana's Ministry of Communities. That
work has 61 externally validated instances of uptake by decision-makers, across
27 countries and four international organisations, a measure audited by the
IGC's government funder. The [record is below](#policy-impact).

The work below was written to be used rather than cited. Several pieces exist
in French, Somali, Arabic or Hindi; ask if you need one.

## Government of Guyana

Before joining the IGC I was embedded in Guyana's Ministry of Communities,
working closely with the Minister, Permanent Secretary and Head of Planning.
Guyana held its first local government elections for 20 years in 2016, and I
helped build local government capacity, particularly through municipal finance
reform.

::: {.pubs}
- **Economist, then Senior Economist and ODI Fellow, Ministry of Communities** (2016–2018)
  [Input to the *Green State Development Strategy* (Office of the President); *Addressing the Challenges Facing the Government Housing Programme* (with the Central Housing and Planning Authority and Ministry of Finance); municipal tax progression, local government renewable energy policy, economic profiles of Guyana's capital towns, and public financial management tools for municipalities]{.venue}
:::

## Policy impact {#policy-impact}

Since joining the IGC's Cities that Work initiative, my work has been taken up
by the government decision-makers below, with each instance externally
validated. The engagements vary in breadth and depth, and the list is not
exhaustive. Policy impact from *Harnessing Global Value Chains for Regional
Development* is tracked separately on the
[LSE Global Investments and Local Development blog](https://blogs.lse.ac.uk/gild/books/).

<details class="more">
<summary>Engagement record, 2018–2025</summary>

- **2025:** Egypt; Ethiopia; Kenya; Liberia; Malawi; Malaysia; Mozambique; Pakistan; South Africa; Zambia; Zanzibar, Tanzania.
- **2024:** Freetown, Sierra Leone (Mayor); Punjab, Pakistan (Executive Director); Cape Town, South Africa (technical staff); Accra, Ghana (technical staff).
